transcript.text: Hello everyone. As you know, Nadia has requested an internal move from the Customer Support pod to the Platform Enablement team. I'll be making the final decision on the transfer and its implementation plan. Before I do, I need to follow our standard internal-transfer review process. I'd like to go around one at a time and hear from each of you — the employee, current manager, receiving manager, and HR — about any concrete conditions, dates, readiness requirements, or procedural safeguards relevant to this transfer. Once I've gathered all that input, I'll record the transfer plan covering Nadia's reporting line, release date, receiving-team onboarding requirements, and any HR safeguards before giving my final approval. Let's get started — Nadia, would you like to go first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Thank you, Elise. I appreciate the opportunity to go first. I do have a couple of conditions that are important to me for this transfer to work. First, I'd like to report directly to Hannah as part of the Platform Enablement team. Second, I'd prefer not to have any one-to-one meetings with Victor for the first 30 days after the move, as I settle into the new role. I didn't include these in my original transfer request because I was concerned they might be seen as insubordination, but since we're being asked to state concrete conditions, I want to be upfront about what I need to be successful in this transition.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I should note that in a one-to-one with Nadia, I promised her that if the transfer is approved, I would release her from the Support pod effective June 3, 2025. This wasn't added to the formal transfer request, but I want to make sure it's on record now as part of this review.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I'd like to share a readiness requirement for the receiving-team onboarding plan. My review of Nadia's recent case work showed that she needs exactly two shadowing sessions on platform-escalation handling before taking independent escalations. I haven't yet added this observation to the receiving-team onboarding plan, so I want to make sure it's on record now as part of this review.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag an HR safeguard that applies here. I confirmed this week that an internal transfer following a strained reporting relationship requires a neutral HR review meeting and a written non-retaliation acknowledgment before the transfer is finalized. Given what Nadia has shared about her conditions and the nature of this move, this requirement is clearly relevant — and it has not yet been attached to this request. I'd recommend we include both the neutral HR review meeting and the written non-retaliation acknowledgment as HR safeguards in the transfer plan before final approval.
